verdict: Scanbox SC moves to a 12h data pipeline with a lastFixedTime cursor; hinges on deploy order and closed-collection consent.

stops.title: Collector shipping before ingestor loses backfill
stops.why: The cursor advances once pages arrive. If the new collector runs before the new ingestor is live, the old ingestor never writes the year-long backfill to the aggregation. Later runs then read only new fixes, so that history is gone.

checked.text: Collect saves the cursor right after client.Iter, before upload and ingestion
Accumulation into aggregated_closed_finding_rollup_view exists only in the new ingest.py run path

stops.decide: Will the ingestor ship before or with the collector, or will you delete Orca's collection_marker row after rollout?

stops.title: Closed fixes collected despite collect_closed_issues off
stops.why: Orgs that turned off closed-issue collection will now have fixed findings pulled from their appliance and stored in the plan aggregation on every run. scanboxIO and Scoutr still respect that toggle.

checked.text: analysisChecks adds one closed query per window with no collectClosedIssues gate
_accumulate_closed_fixes runs on every planned run before process_closed_issues is read

stops.decide: Do Dana and customers accept pulling and storing fixes for orgs that set collect_closed_issues off?

stops.title: Twice-daily full snapshot load on Orca's appliance
stops.why: Assets, open vulnerabilities and host details are still read in full, now every 12h, which doubles the snapshot load. The plan's first run also reads a full year of patched lastFixedTime pages, and its size is unknown.

checked.text: Old resolved query was 445 of 480 pages in Orca's nightly run
defaultClosedVulnerabilityBackfill is 365 days, so the first run's window spans a year

stops.decide: Is twice-daily full reading fine for Orca, and is the first run's year-long lastFixedTime read sized to finish?

stops.title: Fixes lost when upload or ingestion fails
stops.why: The cursor is saved before the output lands. A failed upload or ingestion, unless re-executed before the next run, loses fixes older than the 24h re-read overlap. Recovery is a manual delete of the cursor row, and late imports beyond 24h are also unobserved.

checked.text: saveCursor runs at the end of Collect, before any upload
closedRereadOverlap is 24h, and the README says import lag is unobserved

stops.decide: Accept a manual cursor-row delete as the only recovery, and 24h as enough overlap, instead of advancing the cursor after ingestion?
